title: Compliance curation lane — SOC2 prep scratch
content:
Quick context / intent:
This is a lightweight, messy scratchpad for curating what we actually need to collect for the next SOC2 evidence run. Not canonical — use as a staging area for "what to ask for" and "where to look" before I formalize into the controls inventory page.

Notes to self (stream-of-consciousness):
- We keep getting fragmented asks around key management and backups; consolidate under single control mapping (CC: key-rotation, backup-verification, KMS integration).
- Evidence types: config screenshots + KMS rotation logs (audit), runbook excerpt (ops), ticket showing successful rotation, automated test output (if any).
- Need to reconcile Dedicated vs Hosted model for the same control: docs often show hosted flows only. Add column: deployment-scope = hosted|dedicated|private.
- Short-term: make a lean checklist per control (3–5 artifacts max) so engineers can ship evidence quickly.

Open questions / unresolved:
1) Backup verification cadence — daily snapshots? weekly tests? who signs off? (See INF-4821 thread)
2) For RBAC control: are there separate groups for Console vs Control Plane API? Do we have explicit groups or just SSO mappings?
3) Do Dedicated customers have documented rekey/rotation SLAs? if not, include as gap.

Control mapping sketches (very rough):
- Access reviews (CC-AR-01): owner = security; artifacts = access-review spreadsheet export, Slack thread where review was requested, follow-up ticket.
- KMS rotation (CC-KMS-02): owner = infra; artifacts = KMS rotation job logs (last 6 months), runbook excerpt, PR that introduced automated rotation (if any).
- Change management (CC-CHG-03): owner = release-eng; artifacts = release calendar export, example change ticket with approvals, post-deploy incident review (if applicable).

Evidence hunt plan (where to look):
- Vault / KMS console -> rotation audit logs (query by key alias)
- GitHub -> PRs tagged with infra/ops, search "rotation" and "kms"
- Jira -> filter INF project, label: soc2-evidence (ask Rohan to tag relevant tickets)
- Console dashboards: export user audit CSV for last 90 days (note: pagination limits; may need API access)

Assumptions I am making (call these out when I hand off):
- We will accept exported logs (CSV) plus a short narrative + pointer to retention policy.
- App-level encryption is out of scope for this run (only platform-level KMS).
- Some older Dedicated customers have customer-managed KMS; evidence for those tenants handled separately.

Quick checklist (to convert to formal TODOs):
- [ ] Make scoped checklist template per control (3 artifact slots) — deliver by 2026-03-10
- [ ] Request access: ops-read for Confluence and KMS logs (Rohan)
- [ ] Pull last 6 months KMS rotation logs for default keys (Isabel)
- [ ] Draft narrative for RBAC control explaining SSO mapping and review cadence (Leila)

Messaging snippets (for ticket/ask):
- Headline: "SOC2 evidence request: KMS rotation logs + runbook excerpt"
- Body: "Hi infra team — auditor requested KMS rotation proof for platform keys (last 6 months). Please attach rotation audit export + runbook section that describes automation/rotation policy. If key is customer-managed, note the tenant ID and link to customer docs."

Things to avoid in final artifact:
- Overwhelming auditors with raw data dumps — include a short summary + pointer to raw log with filters/queries used.
- Including PII in screenshots — scrub user IDs or redact.

Next actions (my immediate plan):
1) Meet with Rohan 2026-03-07 to align on INF-4821 and who will pull logs.
2) Build a short checklist template for 8 priority controls and circulate to owners.
3) Convert these sketches to a Confluence draft (link above) and tag PRs/Jira.

Slack pointers / traces: #trust-ops-thread (pinned messages around RBAC), #infra-audit (for log pulls), convo: <slack://channel?team=T12345&id=C67890> (notes exist but messy).

Random fragments / brainstorming (keep):
- Could we run a small smoke test that simulates a rotation and captures the audit trail end-to-end? low-effort, high-confidence artifact.
- Maybe create a "SOC2 starter pack" git repo with scripts to download/export the usual artifacts (KMS, access CSVs, backup manifests) so owners can self-serve.

If I step away and come back: prioritize KMS + RBAC + backups. Everything else can be templated from those three patterns.

---
Revision log (brief):
- 2026-01-19 initial sketch (scoped controls list)
- 2026-02-12 added evidence-hunt checklist, ticket refs
- 2026-03-05 updated next actions and meeting date with Rohan

End of scratchpad. Will prune and push to Confluence when checklist template is solid.
